comment: Golden vectors pinning the repetition battery contract shared by omni-voice-gen qc.py and canonical voice-gen qc.ts (0148 R9). repetitionDetected = detector fired on the transcription only (never source text); flagged = corroborated by duration anomaly -> run-failing issue. Scope note: vectors avoid the known threshold divergence (py uses 3x-max/+15s/rate>15 anomaly thresholds; TS canonical uses 1.5x-max/rate<1.8 with an 8-char floor) — vector texts are sized so both batteries agree on anomaly on/off. Threshold alignment is a separate follow-up.
